title: Now Firefox can select which sites use its VPN, and clear your browsing history with one click
summary: Mozilla released Firefox 161 on Tuesday with a new setting you can use to choose which pages automatically open with the browser's VPN active. Using the "Manage VPN rules" option in Firefox's VPN panel, you can set it to "always on" or "always off" for specific sites, so you don't have to toggle it manually every time you visit certain pages.
